visual.name: nexoraMap
visual.description: Nexora Map — a premium command-center map of Saudi Arabia with Arabic-first RTL design. Fully offline (no tiles, no geocoding): embedded region boundaries, charcoal-and-gold choropleth, glowing borders, cross-filtering selection, smooth zoom and pan, Arabic/Western digits, and Arabic/English localization. Part of the Nexora Suite by Nexora Analysis. Boundary data: Natural Earth (public domain).
